selection: the system phrases that define the pages, the input fields and the buttons of a process catch
description: The keywords of the pages, the input fields and the buttons of the process catch views with their properties and types, so that the pages of a question phrase e.g. the PV calculator are defined by the triples of a use case file and not by code. This file is imported as the last step of the db setup, so that no database id of a tested phrase moves.

words.name: process
words.description: a series of steps that leads to a result e.g. the guided input of the numbers of a calculation

words.name: catch
words.description: the guided collection of the input of a calculation step by step, from one easy question on the start page to the result

words.name: input
words.description: the data that the user enters for a calculation

words.name: label
words.description: the text that names an input field for the user

words.name: phrase
words.description: a word or a triple, which selects or stores a value

words.name: step
words.description: the increment by which the number of an input field changes

words.name: suggestion
words.description: the value that an input field shows before the user has entered one

words.name: location
words.description: a place on the earth e.g. given by a postal code

words.name: choice
words.description: one of a limited number of answers that the user can select

words.name: selector
words.description: an input field to select one phrase of a list of phrases

words.name: list
words.description: phrases in a sorted order e.g. the columns of a table

words.name: start
words.description: the first step of a process

words.name: detail
words.description: the step of a process with the fine tuning of the assumptions

words.name: button
words.description: a control that the user presses to start an action e.g. to go to the next page

words.name: tooltip
words.description: the text shown if the user moves the mouse over a control

words.name: view
words.description: the page that is shown to the user e.g. the next page of a process catch

words.name: proceed
words.description: to continue with the step that follows the current one

words.name: refresh
words.description: to show the page again with the changed input

words.name: back
words.description: the step before the current one

triples.name: zukunft.com system
triples.description: keyword for system internal triples such as the column definitions

triples.name: process catch
triples.description: the guided input of a calculation in four steps: one easy question, the most relevant inputs, the fine tuning and the result

triples.name: process catch field
triples.description: an input field of a process catch view

triples.name: process catch field (system)
triples.description: keyword for the input fields of the process catch views; a field of a question phrase is defined by the triples of the properties below

triples.name: field label
triples.description: the phrase whose name is shown to the user as the label of the field e.g. place of the PV installation

triples.name: field value phrases
triples.description: the phrases that store the entered number as a value e.g. PV installation location

triples.name: field type
triples.description: the type that decides how the field is shown e.g. as a location selector

triples.name: field unit
triples.description: the unit of the number of the field e.g. kWh

triples.name: field limit up
triples.description: the highest number that the field accepts

triples.name: field limit down
triples.description: the lowest number that the field accepts

triples.name: field step
triples.description: the increment of the number of the field

triples.name: field suggestion
triples.description: the number that the field shows before the user has entered one

triples.name: location selector
triples.description: field type to select a place by its name or postal code

triples.name: number with limits
triples.description: field type to enter a number between the field limits in the field steps

triples.name: pre-selection
triples.description: field type to select one of a limited number of answers

triples.name: phrase selector
triples.description: field type to select one phrase of the phrases defined by the field phrase selector

triples.name: phrase selection
triples.description: field type to sort a list of phrases e.g. the main columns of a table

triples.name: field phrase selector
triples.description: the phrases that a phrase selector field offers

triples.name: field phrase selector label
triples.description: the phrase that describes what the selected phrase is used for e.g. Main table columns

triples.name: field phrase selector parent
triples.description: the phrase whose children can be selected e.g. column (system) to select one column of the table

triples.name: field phrase selector value based
triples.description: the phrase whose values offer their phrases for the selection e.g. global warming solution

triples.name: field selection
triples.description: the sorted list of phrases that a phrase selection field shows

triples.name: field selection label
triples.description: the phrase that describes what the sorted list means e.g. Main table columns

triples.name: field selection parent
triples.description: the phrase whose children are listed e.g. main column (system) for the main columns of a table

triples.name: process catch page
triples.description: one of the four pages of a process catch

triples.name: process catch page (system)
triples.description: keyword for the pages of a process catch, which the fields and the buttons of a question phrase are assigned to

triples.name: process catch start page
triples.description: the first page of a process catch with one easy to answer question

triples.name: process catch main page
triples.description: the page of a process catch with the about three inputs that are most relevant for the result

triples.name: process catch detail page
triples.description: the page of a process catch with the fine tuning of the assumptions in tabs

triples.name: process catch result page
triples.description: the last page of a process catch with the calculated result in tabs

triples.name: field page
triples.description: the page of the process catch that shows the field e.g. the process catch main page

triples.name: process catch button
triples.description: a button of a process catch page

triples.name: process catch button (system)
triples.description: keyword for the buttons of the process catch pages; the text in the button is defined by the component, the tooltip and the target by the properties of each button type

triples.name: next button
triples.description: button type to save the input and to open the next page

triples.name: refresh button
triples.description: button type to show the page again with the changed input

triples.name: back button
triples.description: button type to open the page before

triples.name: button next tooltip
triples.description: the phrase whose name is shown as the tooltip of the next button; the text in the button is the ui message of the component

triples.name: button next view
triples.description: the process catch page that the next button opens e.g. the process catch main page

triples.name: button refresh tooltip
triples.description: the phrase whose name is shown as the tooltip of the refresh button

triples.name: button refresh label
triples.description: the phrase whose name is shown in the refresh button e.g. calculate

triples.name: button refresh view
triples.description: the process catch page that the refresh button shows again with the changed input

triples.name: button back tooltip
triples.description: the phrase whose name is shown as the tooltip of the back button

triples.name: button back view
triples.description: the process catch page that the back button opens e.g. the process catch detail page
the place that the user has entered in the geolocator e.g. to select the sun intensity of a PV calculator
